title: 深夜の街
description: 人気のない深夜の街を、静かな湿度と反射で切り取った都市Bロールです。
creator: @fuuuuuuma

tone.light: 街灯と窓明かりの控えめな混合光
tone.colorTemp: 4000K。青緑と鈍い橙を均衡させる
tone.framing: 50mm・目線高・16:9。静止した街路を正面または斜めから捉える
tone.texture: 濡れたアスファルト、古い壁、ガラス、細かな夜霧

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: cinematic B-roll still for video editing and thumbnails
Primary request: an empty city intersection after midnight, wet asphalt reflecting restrained traffic lights and apartment windows
Scene/backdrop: ordinary dense urban neighborhood after light rain, no activity
Subject: intersection, crosswalk geometry, reflections, and buildings, no living subject
Style/medium: photorealistic nocturnal street photography, natural imperfections, subtle fine film grain
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, eye-level, 50mm lens, centered medium-long view, compressed quiet depth
Lighting/mood: mixed street and window light, 4000K balance, hushed lonely mood, realistic blacks with shadow detail
Color palette: deep blue-green, asphalt gray, dull amber
Materials/textures: wet asphalt, weathered concrete, glass, light night mist
Constraints: one coherent real photograph; no people, no faces, no hands, no silhouettes, no readable text, no logos, no brands, no watermark
Avoid: famous landmarks, cyberpunk fantasy, extreme neon, moving traffic, illustration, CGI look, oversaturation
